meta.description: Places a copy of a geometry on every point, for example a leaf on the points of points_on_path or the kinks of trunk_kink.

plant.description: The paths the points sit on, the instances are added to them.

geometry.description: The geometry to place on every point, of a list the first. A link without geometry places nothing.

size.description: The size of the instances, relative to the path at the point.

angle.description: Tilts the instances along the path, positive toward the tip.
